articles.summary: Earlier this month, American Woodmark’s own Jennifer Kimble, Group Controller for our Made-To-Order (MTO) cabinet manufacturing plants, was recognized as a 2025 Women MAKE Awards Honoree—a prestigious national recognition that celebrates women making significant contributions to the manufacturing industry.
articles.title: Jennifer Kimble Honored at 2025 Women MAKE Awards
